query:
SELECT toStartOfMonth(first_upload) AS month,
       count() AS new_packages,
       countIf(n_versions >= 2 AND dateDiff('day', first_upload, second_upload) <= 90) AS new_packages_filtered
FROM (
    SELECT name, min(t) AS first_upload, arraySort(groupArray(t)) AS ts, length(ts) AS n_versions,
           if(n_versions >= 2, ts[2], toDateTime64('2100-01-01 00:00:00', 3)) AS second_upload
    FROM (
        SELECT lower(replaceRegexpAll(name, '[-_.]+', '-')) AS name, version, min(upload_time) AS t
        FROM pypi.projects GROUP BY name, version
    )
    GROUP BY name
)
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
